Unauthenticated Bluesky search is therefore unavailable; discovery comes from Google News and from the verified handles this project follows directly (app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, which does work).

irregularities.detail: Probe of https://www.reddit.com/r/NFL_Discussion/about.json?raw_json=1 returned status=403 (HTTP 403 Blocked). The adapter was SKIPPED rather than retried, so this run has no posts from that platform. Reddit's public JSON endpoints have contested availability in 2026 (some reports say ~60 req/min unauthenticated, others say broadly blocked with 403 since May 2026), so an unreachable probe here is expected and is not treated as a pipeline failure.
